Method of Attack: Encrypt critical data without interfering with other system functions
Lock victims out of essential device functions
Double extortion tactics of encrypting files and exfiltrating data with intention to publish if ransom not paid
Ransom messages demanding ransom payments in cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Monero
Attack Vector: User-initiated actions such as clicking malicious links in phishing emails or visiting compromised websites
Exploitation of system misconfigurations such as unsecured remote desktop connections and weak passwords/access management
Malvertising and drive-by downloads without user interaction
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom messages demanding payments in Bitcoin and Monero
Presence of ransomware notes in multiple directories
